newsitem.title: USA: Roche, Alanex in screening library pact.
newsitem.headline: Roche, Alanex in screening library pact.

text.p: Alanex Corp said Tuesday that it has a three-year agreement to provide compounds from its exploratory libraries on a nonexclusive basis to Roche Holding Ltd.
Alanex, which is privately held, said its exploratory libraries are comprised of individual small molecules with drug-like structures.
Under the terms of the agreement, Roche has the right to exclusively license leads that arise from the use of the Alanex screening libraries.
In return, Alanex receives an upfront technology access fee and annual research support.
The agreement also provides for milestone and royalty payments to Alanex.
Financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
